data.one_liner: Re-exports get_it, watch_it, command_it, and listen_it for a single import.
data.what_it_does: Provides a convenience package that bundles the flutter_it ecosystem: get_it for DI, watch_it for reactive state, command_it for command pattern, and listen_it for ValueListenable utilities. Importing it gives access to all four libraries without adding each separately.
use_when: You need both DI and reactive state management from the flutter_it ecosystem
You want a single import to explore multiple flutter_it packages
You prefer the practical Flutter Architecture approach
avoid_when: You only need one of the underlying packages and want to keep dependencies minimal
You prefer a different state‑management or DI solution
strengths: One‑stop import for four related packages
Works with the Practical Flutter Architecture pattern
All packages are kept up‑to‑date together
weaknesses: Adds all four dependencies even if only some are used
May be larger than importing individual packages
